name: Counterpart
source:
What if you knew there was another version of you living happily with an alternative version of a lost loved one? For four years,  Ayla thought she finally found happiness with her soulmate Jonas. That was until the unfortunate day when he suddenly disappeared from her life in a tragic car accident. How far is she willing to go to take back what she lost? 

[From [url=https://agednoodles.itch.io/counterpart]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
如果你知道有另一个版本的你与另一个版本的失去亲人幸福地生活在一起怎么办？四年来，艾拉以为她终于和她的灵魂伴侣乔纳斯找到了幸福。直到不幸的一天，他因一场悲惨的车祸突然从她的生活中消失了。为了夺回失去的一切，她愿意走多远？

[来自[url=https://agednoodles.itch.io/counterpart]itch.io[/url]]
